strings.BRR_brazilian_revolution_desc:
The once small revolt that started in the river banks of the Araguaia has entered the third phase of the people's war as communist forces have finally managed to capture the states that sit around the Mid-North of Brazil, now that the military regime has shown its true face.

While João Amazonas has successfully managed to organize a revolutionary government in Fortaleza next to his trusty allies Pedro Pomar and Mauricio Grabois, and enjoys popular support in the region, reality is quickly starting to set in as they come to terms with the fact that they sit in one of the poorest and least developed regions of the whole country, making it difficult to supply troops and the local population without sacrifice.
